stories.title: A new Lidl could be coming to Broughton. Here’s what’s been proposed
stories.summary: Plans for a new Lidl store on vacant land next to Broughton Shopping Park have been submitted to Flintshire County Council. The application seeks permission to build a food store on 1.3 hectares of unused grassland at the junction of Chester Road and the shopping park’s access road in Broughton, opposite an existing Aldi supermarket.

stories.title: Coleg Cambria programme delivers 350,000 hours of student support a year across four sites
stories.summary: Thousands of students are benefiting from MADE – a Coleg Cambria programme delivering up to 350,000 hours of coaching and support annually. The service supports more than 5,000 learners in Deeside, Wrexham, Llysfasi and Northop through a network of more than 40 Progress Coaches, with participants receiving up to 70 hours of guidance each year.
